commits.message: Report examples updated.
CHANGELOG.md updated for the 4.11 release
Issue #142 fixed.
Issue #146 - throw an exception in case of zero-length report interval Reported by @portnov
A little tweak in the docs
New boolean parameter hide_connstr added to the export_data() function. Setting this parameter will exclude server connection strings from the dump. Also query obfuscation will have the same effect.
Fixed missed CTE in table stats query
dblink server connection disconnect moved after log_sample_timings() function call.
Bugfix. This commit fixes take_sample() failures on versions older than 16. There was default case entry missing.

This commit should fix take_sample() function failure due to a bug in definition of a pg_statio_all_tables view in postgres catalog till 15 version. Bag caused duplicate entries in this view, which caused unique constraint violation in a sample.

Fix performs manual calls for underlying statistic functions avoiding
the pg_statio_all_tables view usage for versions before 15.

Use relpages instead of relation byte-size for calculation of a scan_rank during a sample. Byte-size based calculation caused "bigint out of range" error on heavy-loaded system. Provided approach should solve this problem without using heavy numeric type. relpages_bytes is not quite accurate, but it should do the trick because this metric is approximation anyway.
Fixed error "FOREACH expression must not be null" in case of unexpected closed dblink connection while performing take_sample(). Issue #133
Added topn upper limit
Import optimization found by Efim Borisov. Using of temporary tables instead of collecting a lot of data in jsonb provides significant performance boost.
Fixed issue #138 reported by @pashamoss
Report examples updated for PostgreSQL 18
Support of pg_stat_kcache 2.3.1
Minor fixes and migration scripts update
Fixed report examples. (#119 by @xinferum)
Old repors deleted and links updated in README.md

Minor fixes and optimizations
Copyright updated
Minor fixes: pg_wait_sampling v1.1.6 support "on cpu" (#114), avoid last_stat_activity truncation (#103)
Grafana dashboards fix for the new statistic views of Postgres 17

This commit fixes take_sample() failure on Postgres 10.  However
get_report() function will fail due to sha224.

This commit fixes a bug on Postgres 13 with pg_stat_statements
1.8. Bug was copy-paste error in fields list of the dblink query.

Fix of empty lines in the report section 'Top SQL by executions'. It
was caused by forgotten filter condition in the corresponding section
of report_struct file.

This commit fixes duplicated entry in the "Top 'idle in transaction'
session states by duration". The cause was in the UNION used in
stat_activity_states function. Fixed by update of stat_activity_states
so it could be used to construct data for the single report and for
differential report.

Division by zero fix. In the statements_dbstats() function normalizing
divizor sum(st.statements) was not put into the nullif call. It caused
the division by zero error in databases without statements executed.
delete_samples() function comments updated in the migration script
delete_samples() functions comments fixed

Import feature improved. It should help to avoid errors while
importing inconsistent dumps. export_data() function can produce
inconsistent dump in the default transaction isolation level read
committed when the sample is completed while data_export() was in
progress.

fixed #95

abnormal session conditions based on filters. Also it tracks session

- Avoid serialization of parallel samples (#48 by @xinferum) caused by locking due to analyze operations.

Release 0.3.5

Report examples fixed in README.md

Signed-off-by: Andrei Zubkov <zubkov@moonset.ru>

v. 0.3.4
- support of new statistics of Postgres 14 (session and WAL statistics).
- optimized report building.
- limited relations sizes collection with defined _size collection policy_ will now collect sizes for only seq-scanned or vacuumed tables in each sample providing useful estimations in reports without overall database objects size collections.
- fixed incorrect database growth value in case of database statistics reset in a report interval.
- interval bounds in the report contains timezone now (reported by @antiorum in #21).
- fixed settings collection. pg_profile dump could not be loaded if there was a postgres updrage on the source system.
- fixed statements aggregation in report tables. Due to different query texts the same statement could appear several times in one report section making it difficult to realize workload of the statement.
minor fix: Field _~SeqBytes_ of report section "Top tables by estimated sequentially scanned volume" was having value of first interval in cells of first and second interval.

v. 0.3.2
- restored statements _queryid_ compatibility with current version of pgcenter utility
- query text storage improved
- linear interpolation of relation sizes slightly optimized
- minor fixes and optimizations
